title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how individuals adopt mask-wearing over time under social influence, information campaigns, supply constraints, and policy mandates.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: People observe mask use among neighbors and update attitudes and behavior via conformity and perceived norms.

interactions.name: information_dissemination
interactions.description: Media sources and public health campaigns alter individuals’ risk perception, attitudes, and policy awareness.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Authorities and venues enforce mask mandates; noncompliance can incur penalties or denial of entry.

interactions.name: mask_purchase
interactions.description: Individuals buy masks from retailers subject to price, inventory, and rationing constraints.

interactions.name: venue_contacts
interactions.description: People interact at workplaces, schools, and public spaces, affecting perceived norms and (optionally) disease transmission.

interactions.name: household_norms
interactions.description: Households shape member behavior via shared norms and resources (e.g., sharing masks).

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of people wearing masks at each time step.

metrics.name: time_to_70_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until mask use first reaches or exceeds 70% of the population.

metrics.name: steady_state_adoption
metrics.description: Average mask adoption over the final 14 days of the simulation.

metrics.name: policy_effect_size
metrics.description: Difference-in-differences in adoption before vs. after mandate compared to a counterfactual or control period.

metrics.name: ses_disparity_index
metrics.description: Inequality in adoption across socioeconomic groups (e.g., absolute gap or Gini of adoption by SES).

metrics.name: stockout_frequency
metrics.description: Proportion of days with retailer stockouts across all retailers.

metrics.name: average_mask_price
metrics.description: Mean price paid per mask over time.

metrics.name: infections_averted
metrics.description: Cases prevented compared to a no-mask counterfactual, if disease transmission is modeled.

validation_criteria.name: convergence_of_adoption
validation_criteria.description: Adoption change over the final 7 days is below a small threshold (e.g., < 0.5 percentage points).

validation_criteria.name: inventory_feasibility
validation_criteria.description: Retailer inventory levels remain non-negative; no negative stock events occur.

validation_criteria.name: calibration_fit_optional
validation_criteria.description: If calibrated to empirical adoption time series, RMSE below a predefined threshold (e.g., < 0.05).
